writing.explanation: Send means a value may be moved to another thread; Sync means &T may be shared with one. They are inferred from a type's fields, which is why Rc is rejected at compile time while Arc is accepted — the difference is an atomic count, and the type system knows it.
writing.feedback: Arc pays for an atomic count and is therefore Send and Sync.
